key_insight: Ink3D bridges 3D asset generation and large-scale video generative models to produce highly detailed textures that traditional 3D models often miss. The core idea is to borrow the visual richness of video models to sculpt 3D objects with far more complex surface appearance.
problem_solved: Existing 3D generative models can create good geometry, but they usually fail to capture intricate, realistic textures because high-quality 3D training data with rich appearance is limited. This paper tackles the texture gap between 3D generation and visual realism.
method: Uses video generative models as a source of strong visual priors for detailed texture synthesis.
Connects 3D asset creation with large-scale video learning to better reproduce complex surface patterns.
Generates 3D objects that preserve geometry while improving texture fidelity and visual richness.
impact: This matters because it offers a practical path to generating more realistic 3D assets without requiring massive labeled 3D texture datasets. For practitioners, it suggests a new hybrid strategy: leverage foundation-scale video models to improve 3D content creation quality.

paper_title: Ink3D: Sculpting 3D Assets with Extremely Complex Textures via Video Generative Models
paper_authors: Yue Han, Chong Li, Zhening Liu, Cong Huang, Fang Deng
